description: This Java class, BreadcrumbsUtils, provides utility methods for constructing breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products in a web shop context. It interacts with category and product entities, builds URLs, and manages breadcrumb items and hierarchy.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a specific category, including parent categories based on lineage.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for a specific product, including its category hierarchy.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content string into a list of category ID strings.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Parses category lineage string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb string from a list of category IDs.
